t:

Identify the true statement influence of Insurer's assets and capital on Retention.

III. Expects immediate rectification and nothing in the clause would operate to increase the liability of the reinsurers beyond agreed limits

t: Which treaty is used mainly for small accounts where the extra administrative burden of a surplus would be too great?
e: Correct answer: Quota share treaty (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Contingent capital solution (from the IC85 question bank).

II. Are repaid to the policyholder at the end of the multi-year policy period
III. Are used to pay for intermediary commission
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
The primary objective of reinsurance is:-

I. Reduce the company's probability of ruin at a price acceptable to the company
II. Stabilize any fluctuation in the insurers annual aggregate claims experience
III. Allow an insurer to accept risks beyond its normal retention
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

e: Correct answer: Contingent capital solution (from the IC85 question bank).

t:

I. Reinsurance of legal liabilities to third parties
II. Protecting property risks loss exposures
III. Accumulation or aggregation of losses arising from an identified event such as Earthquake
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to principle of good faith.

I. The ordinary rule as to disclosure of material facts operates only up to the time the contract is concluded.
II. In the general operation of the treaty the reinsured is bound to exercise the utmost good faith towards his reinsurer, even though this must occur after the contract was concluded.
III. In modern treaty practice the continuing duty of disclosure is normally expressly stated within the terms and conditions of the formal treaty wording.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

In which type of reinsurance business premium volume can be built up faster?

I. Facultative
II. Treaty
III. Proportional

II. Claims under policies issued or renewed during the contract period are covered no matter in which year they may occur
III. At termination, the reinsurer is not liable for losses occurring after the contract ends, although the original policy may remain in force

The assessment of a company's net account accumulations is done:-
